# Shipping checklist

Laminated copy on the packing table. Packer initials every box.

1. Arm passed calibration this week (row in test log with PASS)
2. Serial label under the base matches the packing slip
3. Calibration JSON copied to the share
4. Calibration printout (check_pose.py report) in the box
5. Leader arm included if ordered (check the order)
6. Bus driver board + USB cable
7. Power supply matching the variant (12 V 5 A or 7.4 V 5 A) - check the label!
8. Spare horn screws (bag of 6) and allen keys
9. Quick start card
10. Box weight 3.6-4.4 kg (outside that range = something missing or extra)
11. Packer initials + date on the box flap
